README.md (lines 1-84 of 84)
 1| # TaskForge
 2| 
 3| A stdlib-only Python task service backed by SQLite. No third-party
 4| dependencies — just the Python standard library.
 5| 
 6| ## Layout
 7| 
 8| - `taskforge/` — package (`__main__.py` CLI, `db.py` storage, `server.py` HTTP API)
 9| - `test_taskforge.py` — unittest suite
10| - `README.md` — this file
11| 
12| ## CLI
13| 
14| Start the HTTP service (binds `127.0.0.1`):
15| 
16| ```
17| python -m taskforge serve --db /path/to/tasks.db --port 8000
18| ```
19| 
20| Add a task:
21| 
22| ```
23| python -m taskforge add --db /path/to/tasks.db --title "Write docs"
24| ```
25| 
26| List task titles:
27| 
28| ```
29| python -m taskforge list --db /path/to/tasks.db
30| ```
31| 
32| ## HTTP API
33| 
34| All bodies and responses are JSON.
35| 
36| | Method | Path | Description |
37| |--------|------|-------------|
38| | `GET` | `/` | HTML web UI for managing tasks |
39| | `GET` | `/tasks` | List all tasks: `[{id, title, done}, ...]` |
40| | `POST` | `/tasks` | Create `{"title": "..."}` → `201 {id, title, done}` |
41| | `PATCH` | `/tasks/ID` | Update `{"done": true}` → updated task object |
42| 
43| Query parameters:
44| 
45| - `GET /tasks?done=true` / `?done=false` filters by completion.
46| - Any other `done` value (or malformed requests) returns `400`.
47| 
48| Errors:
49| 
50| - Blank or non-string `title`, missing/invalid JSON → `400`
51| - Unknown task ID (PATCH) → `404`
52| 
53| ### Idempotency
54| 
55| `POST /tasks` with an `Idempotency-Key` header replays the same task:
56| repeating the key returns the original task's `id` instead of creating a
57| duplicate. The check and insert happen in a single `BEGIN IMMEDIATE`
58| transaction, so it is safe under concurrent requests.
59| 
60| ### Concurrency and persistence
61| 
62| Writes use `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transactions on a WAL-mode SQLite database,
63| so concurrent writers are serialized by SQLite itself. All data lives in
64| the SQLite file given by `--db` and persists across restarts.
65| 
66| ## Schema (v1)
67| 
68| ```sql
69| CREATE TABLE tasks (
70|     id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
71|     title TEXT NOT NULL,
72|     done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
73| );
74| ```
75| 
76| An `idempotency_keys` table is also maintained internally.
77| 
78| ## Tests
79| 
80| Run the test suite with the standard library test runner:
81| 
82| ```
83| python -m unittest discover
84| ```
